title: Act: Add SceneObject.onHover and emit objectHover from BootScene
summary: SceneObject exposes a hover listener; BootScene forwards it to phaserToReact
description: Add a hoverListener to SceneObject invoked from the existing handle.onHover callback for visible objects, and register it in BootScene.create to emit objectHover.
acceptance_criteria: SceneObject.onHover listener receives objectId and over for visible objects
BootScene emits objectHover with id or null
definition_of_done: Hover in and out emits objectHover

steps.symbol: SceneObject (field + constructor hover handler + onHover method)
steps.action: Add a private field hoverListener, call it inside the existing handle.onHover callback after the visible check, and add a public onHover method that stores the callback.
steps.expected: SceneObject.onHover registers a listener called with objectId and over when a visible object is hovered

steps.action: After the onInteract registration add an onHover registration that emits objectHover with the id when over is true and null when over is false.
steps.code: this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.onHover((e) => phaserToReact.emit('objectHover', { id: e.over ? e.objectId : null })));
steps.expected: Hovering a scene object emits objectHover on phaserToReact
